MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

2. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 30
   C. 60
   D. 19

4. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23.6
   D. 23

5. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)

   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7

   B. 17
   C. 34
   D. 22

7. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 36
   C. 7
   D. 18

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 22

9. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

11. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 12.5
   C. 6
   D. 25

12. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

13. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)

   D. 1

   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

15. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 42
   C. 21
   D. 90

17. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

18. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

19. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

20. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

21. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

22. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 33

23. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 121
   D. 22

24. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

25. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 1
   C. 7
   D. 7

26. Solve for x: x + 3 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 10
   C. 7
   D. 3

27. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

28. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1

   D. 12

29. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 10

30. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 24
